newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish rate soft landing toward German - BoS.
newsitem.headline: Spanish rate soft landing toward German - BoS.

text.p: Spanish central bank Governor Luis Angel Rojo said on Wednesday that short-term interest rates among euro founders will fall toward their German counterparts, and added that Spain is following a "soft landing" approach.
"The base short-term rate won't be as low as the current German rate, but a bit higher because otherwise it would be an excessive risk for some countries," he said.
Currently, the German repo rate is at three percent. The Spanish key money market rate is at 5.25 percent.
As for Spain, Rojo told a parliamentary commission, "(Spain) is in a soft landing. What is important is that the strategy is the right one, and that we are not in too much of a hurry".
